title: BUGFIX — Skip ClipDetection stage when ViralTikTokDownloader returns 0 clips
rationale: Every pipeline run wastes 10 minutes because ClipDetectionAgent tries to LLM-score 45 stage-2 metadata discoveries when ViralTikTokDownloader returns 0 (RapidAPI 403 subscription lapsed). ClipDetection is designed for actual downloaded video files, not trend metadata. When viralClipsCount===0, skip stage 3 entirely — InsightAgent static-fallback handles pipeline continuation.

tasks.description: In agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts, around lines 149-172: after stage 2.5 viral-tiktok, track viralClipsCount separately. Change the stage 3 guard from `if (discoveries.length > 0)` to `if (viralClipsCount > 0)`. This ensures ClipDetection only runs when there are actual viral TikTok video files to analyze. Add a log line: '[Orchestrator] Skipping stage 3 (no viral clips from stage 2.5)' when skipped.
